> Shards in the shape of a wolf, held together by the song. Fast, and half of it is gaps: some of your shots will find them.

## Ability

Dodge: Has a chance to completely ignore an attack.

## How to spot its attack

Fastest bite of all: a third of a second from the lunge to the jaws. A quick hop to one side means your shot missed it.
